readers.what: _entry_key returns the client key, else the relationship key, that the refresh compares between builds; a re-key changes it while the entry and its account ids stay.
disappeared_entries lists each previous entry whose key the new build lacks; a re-keyed account is listed under its old key, so it reads as disappeared.
resolve_disappeared holds, not carries, a disappeared entry whose old key is still in the source snapshot; a re-keyed account whose account id stays in the source is held.
The served entry_id hashes firm, client_id, relationship_id and account_ids; a re-key changes the client and relationship terms, so the same account set gets a new entry_id.
browse_rank maps each entry_id to its sort position; the re-keyed entry gets a new entry_id, so the old entry_id has no rank in the new directory.
resolve selects by ids.client_id equality; after a re-key the old client_id matches no entry, so a client_id selection finds nothing for that account set.
resolve selects by ids.relationship_id equality; the re-keyed entry carries the relationship key so it matches, and an account-level entry has no relationship_id.
The runner entry_key returns client_id else relationship_id, the key carry_forward_removed compares; the re-keyed entry keeps its account ids under the new key.
carry_forward_removed holds, not carries, a previous entry whose key is still in the source; a re-keyed account keeps its account-level key in the source, so its old entry is held.
run_firm refuses the landing when any previous key is held; each re-keyed account adds one held key, so while the guard stands the whole build lands nothing.
source_client_ids mints a client key for every raw source key, relationship and account alike; a re-key adds the relationship key and the account-level key stays listed.
hmac_list_forms hashes the minted account ids into the HMAC list; the client key is never an input, so an unchanged account set gives the same forms under any key.
run_firm passes every entry's account_ids to emit_hmac_list; an unchanged account set leaves the list unchanged, and no client key reaches the HMAC forms.
The filled-report reader is addressed by a client_id it is handed; this file does not show whether that value is the directory ids.client_id, so the re-key effect is not readable here.
marked_now counts the keys of TERMINATED entries carrying a source_removed_on marker; a re-keyed account carried forward keeps its old key and is counted under it, and the new key is never marked.

release_path.what: The SSM build copies the bundle at bundle_uri (refresh.py:768) to the host, extracts it and runs directory_runner.py from it (refresh.py:739); a changed runner reaches the build only via a new bundle object.
